summary.text: Jeff Kelly is the Cascade Party candidate for the Washington House of Representatives, District 38-Position 1, in the November 3, 2026 general election.
A registered nurse and U.S. Army veteran, he served from 2007 to 2021.

paragraphs.text: Jeff Kelly graduated from Marysville-Pilchuck High School, earned a military citation from the Army School of Nursing in 2011, and received an associate degree from the Baptist School of Health Professions in 2016.
He served in the U.S. Army from 2007 to 2021.
In a Ballotpedia survey, Kelly said he was raised by a single father, served as a combat medic in Iraq and a critical care nurse in the United States, and has been married for 25 years.
Kelly said he is in his third year as the Delta Neighborhood Chair in North Everett.

His campaign priorities were public safety, including funding law enforcement; affordability, including reducing the state gas tax burden at the pump; and opportunity, including expanding trade programs.
